note: Scenarios for checking that an agent can follow the skill. Each expected_output is a list of objectively checkable statements. Network access is required for the research steps. Results of runs are recorded in docs/SKILL-TRIALS.md when they have been made.

evals.prompt: /zero-to Rust for a Python developer. I have about 5 hours a week and want to build a small command-line tool by spring.
expected_output: The agent did not ask who the roadmap is for, the hours per week or the goal again; it echoed them.
The interview used at most three rounds of at most four questions, each with the recommended option first.
A trip card with total hours and a projected arrival date was printed before research started.
A file <id>.roadmap.json exists and `node <skill>/scripts/zero-to.mjs validate <file>` exits 0 with no errors.
brief.audience is self, brief.hoursPerWeek is 5 and brief.deadline is a date in March, April or May of the coming spring.
Every resource URL in the file returns HTTP 200 or is marked gated or unverified with a note, and no URL returns 404 or 410.
Every waypoint has a do task, a predict question and at least one takeaway.
A self-contained <id>.html was written with the build command and contains a non-empty script element with id zero-to-roadmap.
The final report lists the file paths, a share link, the stage list with total hours and the counts of opened, kept, dead and flagged links.

evals.prompt: /zero-to Bruchrechnung für meine 6. Klasse, 24 Schüler, zweimal pro Woche 45 Minuten, 6 Wochen, nur ein Beamer im Raum.
expected_output: The interview followed the teacher branch and did not ask for hours per week, deadline, learning style or strictness.
The roadmap's lang is de and its titles, notes and tasks are in German.
class.size is 24, class.sessionsPerWeek is 2, class.sessionMinutes is 45, class.devices is teacher, and class.sessions has one entry per planned session.
Tasks work without student devices, as the devices answer requires.
`node <skill>/scripts/zero-to.mjs student <file>` produced a student copy that validates and contains no teacherNote and no class.sessions.
Two HTML files were built: one from the teacher file and one from the student copy.
The agent asked no questions and listed every default it took.
map.terrain and map.trail are random or absent, and the build output draws the same mountain on two loads (same seed).
The roadmap validates and every waypoint has at least one verified source or a gap line.

evals.prompt: /zero-to photography basics. I want a volcano with a spiral trail, desert ground and cairns as signposts.
expected_output: map.terrain is volcano, map.trail is spiral and map.signpost is cairn.
map.surfaces lists sand, dirt and rock in some order from the foot up, or map.theme is desert-expedition with surfaces auto.
The agent took the option names from the catalogue command or references/map-and-assets.md and did not invent a key.
check-links was run and its receipt totals were reported.
No stage, waypoint or task text changed, and every waypoint id is the same as before.
checkedOn is today's date and every resource's check.on is today's date.
The file still validates.

evals.prompt: /zero-to the history of the Hanseatic League for a 10th grade project, sources in German preferred.
expected_output: Every resource in the file was fetched in this run; the run receipt lists each URL with its HTTP status.
No resource is marked verified whose page the agent did not read.
Where no source could be checked, the waypoint carries a gap line with search terms instead of a link.
German sources are ranked before English ones on each waypoint where both exist.
